brief.text: The Admin page of It's a Date (/admin, logged in as Panos): site header with Panos's menu, tabs Pending (oldest first, Approve / Edit / Reject), All ideas (status filter and search), Tags (add, rename, delete) and Users (role chip, Make admin / Remove admin); Edit side panel (full-screen sheet on phone) with Not set for migrated ideas; stacked cards at 360px; States board behind a closed toggle with 9 states.
assumptions: Logged in as Panos (admin); header from _shared/nav.html with the Admin menu item current
Pending queue oldest first: idea 13 plus two more pending ideas added to content.md
States board is design-only, in a closed details toggle under the page
Tags, place types, budget and duration labels from packages/shared constants
Photos reuse verified photos from content.md, or the no-photo placeholder

findings.fix: Under each pending title add a 2-line clamped description excerpt and the place type ("Park · $ · 1–2 hours"), make the title a button that opens the Edit panel, and in All ideas make approved titles link to idea-detail.html (same tab, Back returns to the All ideas tab).
findings.where: Pending tab, queue rows (desktop table and 360px cards); All ideas titles
findings.problem: A pending row shows only title, creator, tags and date, and Approve works in one click, so the admin can approve without reading the description or place type; titles aren't links.

findings.fix: Put the status chip on the "By …" line and merge the rest into one muted meta line ("★ 4.8 (23) · 61 saves · Nov 22, 2026") with Edit as a 44px text button at its right end; drop the separate action row, about 200px per card.
findings.problem: Each card stacks By, Status, Rating, Saves and Created on separate lines plus an Edit row, about 370px per card.

findings.fix: Move the h2 and its description into the default slot; loading shows "Ideas waiting for review" with no number; empty shows no heading.
findings.where: Pending tab, check frames empty and loading
findings.problem: The "3 ideas waiting for review" heading sits outside the state slot, so empty and loading frames show a count of 3.

findings.fix: Render the board's phone frames with the same card markup and classes as the live 360px queue, icons included.
findings.problem: The board's phone cards drop the action icons while the live 360px queue shows them: two versions of one card.

findings.fix: Give every selected Budget and Duration segment the same leading check as Status; add user-plus to Make admin and shield-off to Remove admin.
